item.title: A message from: Mrs. Longval
item.description: Just a reminder that our HYROX Team information meeting is happening TODAY at 11:00 AM in the weight room with Mrs. Longval! If you're interested in running, strength training, or challenging yourself in a fun fitness competition, come find out what HYROX is all about! Students can compete individually or in teams of two. Sign-up sheets are posted on the bulletin board outside the gym foyer, near the vending machine. Don't have a partner? No problem! We can help you find one! We hope to see you there!

item.title: A message from: Mrs. Longval
item.description: Reminding all Specialist High Skills Major Health and Wellness Students to please bring in their permission forms for next week's Health Fair in Kemptville. Please chat with Mrs. Longval if you have any questions.

item.title: A message from Mr Warner:
item.description: St. Thomas Aquinas basketball has represented our region at the Arnprior-Renfew tournament for years - usually outmatched, with few wins, but always with heart and class. Well this past weekend the Junior Girls' team won the entire tournament beating 3 EOSSAA level teams on their way to the title! This group is relentless, plays incredibly hard, and truly represents the STA spirit! We couldn't be more proud of you girls, congratulations on a well deserved tournament win! You are awesome!!

item.title: A message from Ms. Baron:
item.description: Want to treat a friend? We will be selling Ghosty-Grams for $2 during High School lunch today and tomorrow. Bring your toonies! Another message from Ms. Baron and Ms. Clune to all Junior and Senior boys. There will be a callback list for basketball tryouts posted in the Phys. Ed foyer at lunch today. To all those not on the list, thank you for trying out, we hope to see you again next year! If anyone has any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to Ms. Clune or come see Ms. Baron at lunch. Thank you!
